notes.title: Battle Robot Dog and Credit Mining Tool arrived!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/5884488bcb69eca413906bd8b4d8587df39d5eed.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled experience as we introduce two game-changing features in one massive update! [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/ea329317b6b6fa39f8590c3751b32c6aee519d64.png[/img]

[h3]First up, buy your new mechanical best friend in the Robot Shop: The Robot Combat dog![/h3]
Equip it to your arsenal and watch as it unleashes havoc on your enemies with unparalleled precision.
Let your robot dog help you fight the monsters threatening the city!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/fe33775d1c1f5dcedc278924f58caf9b13a48c17.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/f572af0123bea8285d13345c2a3e5909fd5a942d.png[/img]

[h1]But that's not all![/h1] 

[h3]We're also introducing a groundbreaking addition: an Credit Mining Tool![/h3]
Now, effortlessly generate wealth while you focus on dating lonely babes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/e05da6d8f60e9f1f761c7fc699b0825cfcc22dc7.png[/img]
Discover your newly acquired mining tool and robot dog waiting in your apartment, ready to defend your home and accompany you into battle against the monstrous invaders that have overrun the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/92f302e5ee28411447f75a49a4d15efb54de160e.png[/img]
Purchase upgrades to enhance your mining tool, enabling it to generate credits at a faster rate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/d1bd5aaab8b1de88b2dfd1c53e403f5a79d93cad.png[/img]

With these dynamic enhancements, your gaming experience just got even more electrifying!
Dive into the action today and witness the future of gaming unfold before your eyes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44302050/663248ca5b8bc1ecad834fd8cec6f4cf5cacb9aa.png[/img]
